label: Whatever has the nine SIMPLE_4, PERFECT_2, INFINITE_1 attributes operates from itself
paraphrase: Open premise, analyst formulation, unattributed; the weak version of STMT-PURE-ACT-OPERATES. Whatever is simple, universally perfect, supremely good, the one GOD_4, infinite, altogether immutable (in potency in no respect, PURE_ACT), eternal, and has intellect and will operates from itself (the primitive Operates of SelfOperationLife: an immanent operation, actio quae manet in agente, q.18 a.3 ad 1; not motion). Scoped exactly to what the restated sufficiency NineSufficeForDeiFilius quantifies over. Since altogether immutability is pure act, it is STMT-PURE-ACT-OPERATES restricted to the beings that also have the other eight; it is strictly weaker (Control.Controls part 1: an inert pure act with no intellect satisfies it and falsifies the strong version). It says nothing of a pure act without the nine, so a causally inert abstract object, if the Being domain has one, is outside its scope. Because the nine include HAS_INTELLECT_1, it speaks only of beings with intellect. q.18 a.3 ad 2 says of God that he is his own understanding and his own living; that is the nearest source support, and no claim states this premise.
